title: Google Research GFSA: Learning Graph Structure With Finite-State Automaton Absorption & Richardson Linear Solvers
author: repo-triad-forge

edges.description: Subproject gfsa in snapshot google-research-master (archive snapshot, non-git); NeurIPS 2020 / arXiv:2007.04929
Complements GNN / AST static-analysis graph representations in https://github.com/google-research/google-research

claims.assertion: automaton_builder.py defines SpecialActions (FINISH, BACKTRACK, FAIL) and immutable hashed route keys InRouteType(node_type, in_edge) / InOutRouteType(node_type, in_edge, out_edge) with sentinel SOURCE_INITIAL to parameterize graph MDP policies over AST schemas.

linear_solvers.py solves absorbing Markov chain visit counts (I - P)^{-1} b via fixed-step Richardson iteration inside jax.lax.fori_loop wrapped in jax.lax.custom_linear_solve for implicit reverse-mode differentiation without unrolling forward steps.

distilled_learning: Encode AST and codebase traversal policies using typed (node_type, in_edge, out_edge) finite-state automaton routes and compute stationary/absorbing transition equilibrium via implicit differentiation (custom_linear_solve) over Richardson iterations.
